source_filter.description: The retrieval scope, as the caller named it: one entry per --source, order preserved (primary scope first), de-duplicated. null means no scope -- an --all-sources read. Retyped from a bare string when --source became repeatable, so a single-source retrieval now reports ["proj"] rather than "proj"; that retype took schema_version 1 -> 2, because this file is vendored into the wheel (pyproject.toml) and a pinned copy would otherwise reject a fresh bundle while it truthfully reported the version that copy claims to handle.
